theme.mode: Light + Dark mode support with toggle
theme.philosophy: Apple + Linear + Stripe Dashboard + Notion + Vercel aesthetic. Premium, minimal, modern, elegant, fast, clean, beautiful. No outdated ERP aesthetics.

typography.headings: Space Grotesk (tracking-tight or tracking-tighter for impact)

left_panel.content: Large mobility hero image/looping video. Floating live KPI cards (Today's Bookings, Active Vendors, Vehicles Online, Cities, Revenue) with smooth spring floating animations.

right_panel.content: Official WavyGo logo (Green on light mode, White on dark mode), 'Welcome to WavyGo OS', Login Form (Email, Password, Forgot Password, Remember Me, Sign In button).
right_panel.footer: WAVYGO MOBILITY SERVICES PRIVATE LIMITED | CIN: U77100BR2025PTC077095

sidebar.bottom_element: Dynamic user profile (photo, name, role, online status)

founder_dashboard.grid_style: High Density Bento Grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4) with gap-4 or gap-6. No jagged bottoms.
founder_dashboard.charts: Revenue chart, Booking chart, City Performance
founder_dashboard.widgets: Today's Tasks, Upcoming Calendar, Quick Actions, Recent Activity, Opportunity Summary

components.buttons: Modern, crisp edges or pill-shaped. Interaction animations (scale 0.98 active state). Primary color ONLY for primary actions.
components.cards: Go flat, rectangular, dense styles. 1px subtle border, flat background. Hover: slight lift (-translate-y-1) and shadow-lg.
components.inputs: Shadcn-based, minimalist. Focus rings must be high-contrast and use brand primary color.
components.dropdowns: Solid background (NO transparent backgrounds). 1px border, subtle ambient shadow.
components.badges: Subtle tint backgrounds (e.g., bg-green-100 text-green-800 for light mode).
components.tables: Dense, crisp lines. Hover state on rows. No zebra striping, use 1px bottom border per row.
components.charts: Shadcn/Recharts. Clean lines, minimal axes, glassmorphic tooltips.
components.toasts: Use Sonner. Crisp edges, minimalist icons.

motion.transitions: Use specific properties (e.g., transition: transform 0.2s ease). NEVER use 'transition: all'.
motion.hover_states: Every interactive element needs a micro-animation.

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use sparingly on sticky headers/navs: backdrop-blur-xl with high opacity bg (e.g., bg-white/80 or bg-black/60) + 1px inner stroke.
visual_enhancers.neumorphism: Avoid heavy shadows. Use 1px borders to define shapes.
visual_enhancers.icons: Use 'lucide-react' for all standard icons. Crisp and consistent stroke widths.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure minimum 4.5:1 text contrast. Do not use dark-on-dark text.
accessibility.testing_attributes: All interactive/key elements MUST include 'data-testid' in kebab-case (e.g., data-testid='login-submit-button').
accessibility.focus: Clear focus states on all inputs and buttons.

media.logo_rules: Use OFFICIAL green WavyGo logo (uploaded PDF) on light mode. OFFICIAL white WavyGo logo on dark mode. Never generate AI logo, never redesign, modify colors, or stretch.

login_hero_images.description: Mumbai scooter traffic - Urban Indian mobility context
Sleek electric bike in urban area at night

explicit_avoid_list: No dark-on-dark text or poor contrast elements.
No transparent backgrounds for dropdowns, headers, or overlays where content overlaps.
Never rename or reorder the sidebar items.
instructions_to_main_agent: Prioritize Shadcn UI components but heavily customize them to match the Apple/Linear/Stripe aesthetic.
Execute purely in React (.js) using Tailwind CSS.
Implement the full App Shell logic with React Context or standard state for sidebar toggling and theme switching.
The Founder Dashboard must use CSS Grid seamlessly to prevent jagged edges.
For the login split screen, animate the floating KPI cards using Framer Motion.
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Left-align text by default. Center alignment should only be used intentionally for visual hierarchy.
Ensure all buttons have hover, active, and focus states explicitly defined.
Missing images must use the provided Unsplash URLs; never use placeholder text or dummy image services.
